notes.title: 小更新
notes.content:
1. 加入对话功能，利用星火大模型实现。
2. 自动连击功能，可以挂机自动点击并获取掉落物。
3. 加入新春倒计时
4. 暂时 隐藏木鱼元素

notes.title: 0817Update——更新说明
notes.content:
1.修复了成就bug，如果之前成就没有掉落，进入游戏就会检测并补偿，取决于你之前的云存档。
2.掉落物进行每分钟的强制检测，不需要任何点击，挂着就行。
3.加入静音功能。
4.左右键调整画面并加入存储。
5.取消连按时间间隔可以随便速度。

1. Fixed the achievement bug. If the previous achievements did not drop, they will be detected and compensated upon entering the game, depending on your previous cloud save.
2. Mandatory detection of falling objects every minute.
3. Add mute function.
4. Use the left and right buttons to adjust the screen and add storage.
5. Cancel the continuous pressing time interval at any speed.

notes.title: CAISHENB is done!!!
notes.content:
Previously, according to Steam's review, the release was scheduled for August 2nd. However, starting from August, I was transferred to Huzhou to work out for six months. A few days ago, I was very busy and didn't have time to do it. Today, I finally had time to complete the release process.
As I mentioned before, this game is not a financial product, purely for fun. If you want these emojis, please open and play them as soon as possible, because I will regularly update the dropped items every week, and they are all unique items

and， Because I have my own job, I don't want to take up too much of my experience playing games. As a core employee, updating things may be more Buddhist. Please forgive me, but weekly updates of emojis are definitely guaranteed.

and， In fact, there are some other plans for this game, of course, they are also for practicing (mainly to test most of Steam's features in this game), and the later plans can be found on the GitHub homepage [URL]= https://github.com/CAISHENB ] https://github.com/CAISHENB [/url]
I should share the source code to this Git account when the game stabilizes.

Finally, I understand that everyone has objections or other concerns about this game. Please show mercy~~~
